comments.en:
A person should always view himself as leaning towards death, with the possibility that he might die at any time. Thus, he may be found as a sinner.
Therefore, one should always repent from his sins immediately and should not say: "When I grow older, I will repent," for perhaps he will die before he grows older. This was implied by the wise counsel given by Solomon [Ecclesiastes 9:8]: "At all times, your clothes should be white."
comments.he: לְעוֹלָם יִרְאֶה אָדָם עַצְמוֹ כְּאִלּוּ הוּא נוֹטֶה לָמוּת וְשֶׁמָּא יָמוּת בִּשְׁעָתוֹ וְנִמְצָא עוֹמֵד בְּחֶטְאוֹ. לְפִיכָךְ יָשׁוּב מֵחֲטָאָיו מִיָּד וְלֹא יֵאָמֵר כְּשֶׁאַזְקִין אָשׁוּב שֶׁמָּא יָמוּת טֶרֶם שֶׁיַּזְקִין. הוּא שֶׁשְּׁלֹמֹה אָמַר בְּחָכְמָתוֹ (קהלת ט ח) "בְּכָל עֵת יִהְיוּ בְגָדֶיךָ לְבָנִים":
היום קצר. העולם הזה:
ובעל הבית דוחק. זה הקב״ה שנא' בו והגית בו יומם ולילה:

comments.en: Let not this Book of the Teaching cease from your lips, but recite it day and night, so that you may observe faithfully all that is written in it. Only then will you prosper in your undertakings and only then will you be successful.
comments.he: לֹֽא־יָמ֡וּשׁ סֵ֩פֶר֩ הַתּוֹרָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה מִפִּ֗יךָ וְהָגִ֤יתָ בּוֹ֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה לְמַ֙עַן֙ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּכׇל־הַכָּת֖וּב בּ֑וֹ כִּי־אָ֛ז תַּצְלִ֥יחַ אֶת־דְּרָכֶ֖ךָ וְאָ֥ז תַּשְׂכִּֽיל׃

sections.en: Rabbi Tarfon said: the day is short, and the work is plentiful, and the laborers are indolent, and the reward is great, and the master of the house is insistent.
sections.he: רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן אוֹמֵר, הַיּוֹם קָצָר וְהַמְּלָאכָה מְרֻבָּה, וְהַפּוֹעֲלִים עֲצֵלִים, וְהַשָּׂכָר הַרְבֵּה, וּבַעַל הַבַּיִת דּוֹחֵק:

en: מַתָּן m. (Biblical Hebrew; נָתַן) giving, gift.—מַתּן תורה giving of the Law, revelation at Mount Sinai. Berakhot 58ᵃ bottom of page Breishit Rabbah section (Parashah) 34; and from—מ׳ שכר reward. Pirkei Avot II, 16; and from—מ׳ דמים sprinkling or smearing the blood (on the altar &c.). Rosh Hashanah 28ᵇ; and from—Zevachim VIII, 10 מַתַּן ארבע במ׳ ארבע blood requiring four applications mixed with &c.; Rosh Hashanah l. common gender.; Yerushalmi Eruvin X, end, 26ᵈ; Bavli Eruvin 100ᵃ. Ib. מ׳ ארבע במ׳ אחת (Zevachim l. common gender. במתנה) blood requiring four applications mixed with blood requiring one application; and from—מַשָּׂא ומַ׳, see מַשָּׂא.

עָתִיד, עֲתִידָה f. (Biblical Hebrew; עָתַד) standing (compare עָמַד); ready, designated; in future. Megillah 15ᵇ; Sanhedrin 111ᵇ ע׳ הקב"ה להיות וכ׳ at a future time the Lord shall be a crown on the head of every righteous man. Shabbat 138ᵇ ע׳ תורה שתשתכח וכ׳ a time will come when the Law will be forgotten in Israel; and from—הֶעָ׳ לָבֹא (or הֶעָ׳) the future. Ketubot 87ᵃ משביעין אותה על הע׳ לבא we administer an oath to her in regard to her conduct in the future, opposed על שעבר; and from—Esp. לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא (abbrev. לע"ל) in the Messianic future; in the hereafter (see עוֹלָם). Pirkei Avot Zar. 3ᵇ לע"ל באין אומות וכ׳ in the Messianic days the nations of the world will come and ask to be converted. Ib. אין גהינם לע"ל there is no Gehenna (hell) in the hereafter, but the Lord leads the sun forth &c. Pirkei Avot II, 16 ודע שמתן … לע"ל but remember that the reward of the righteous is reserved for the hereafter; and from—plural עֲתִידִים, עֲתִידִין; עֲתִידוֹת. Berakhot 43ᵇ ע׳ בחורי ישראל וכ׳ the time will come when the youths of Israel shall give forth a flavor &c. Shabbat 152ᵇ ע׳ צדיקים דהוו עפרא (even) the righteous are destined to turn to dust. Yevamot 63ᵃ ע׳ כל בעלי … שיעמדו וכ׳ time will be when all tradesmen will turn to agriculture; and from—[Tosefta Kelim Bava Metzia VII, 12 עתידין, see עֲכִירִים.]

שָׂכָר m. (Biblical Hebrew; שָׂכַר) wages, profit, reward. Shevuot VIII, 1, and e. נושא ש׳ he that receives wages (for watching), see שׁוֹמֵר. Sukkah 29ᵇ שְׂכַר שכיר, see עָשַׁק. Bava Metzia 112ᵃ כל הכובש שְׂ׳ וכ׳ he that delays the payment of the hired man’s wages, is considered as if taking his life. Pirkei Avot V, 11 יצא שְׂכָרוֹ וכ׳, see הֶפְסֵד. Bava Kamma 116ᵃ, and e. אין לו אלא שְׂכָרוֹ he can claim only the ordinary laborer’s pay, see שָׁלֵם II; and from—Esp. divine reward. Eruvin 22ᵃ (reference. to Devarim VII, 11) היום לעשותם … למחר לקכל שְׂכָרָם ‘to do them to-day’, and not to do them to-morrow (do not procrastinate); ‘to do them to-day’, and to receive the reward for them tomorrow (expect not immediate reward). Ib. 65ᵃ לא נכרא יין … לשלם ש׳ לרשעים wine has been created for the purpose of comforting (cheering up) mourners and paying reward to the wicked (for what good they may do, in this world); Bamidabar Rabbah section (Parashah) 104. Pirkei Avot II, 16 נאמן … שְׂכַר פעולתך thy employer may be trusted that he will pay thee the wages due for thy work. Ib. ודע שמתן שְׂכָרָם וכ׳ but keep in mind that the reward of the righteous is reserved for the hereafter; and from—בִּשְׂכַר as a reward for, on account of (compare זְבוּת). Sotah 11ᵇ בש׳ נשים צדקניות וכ׳ for the sake of the righteous women of that generation were the Israelites redeemed; Shemot Rabbah section (Parashah) 1. Chullin 88ᵇ בש׳ שאמר וכ׳ as a reward for what Abraham our father said (Breishit XVIII, 27) &c. Shemot Rabbah section (Parashah) 45 בש׳ שלש זכה לשלש on account of three things he (Moses) was granted three things; בש׳ ויסתר וכ׳ on account of ‘he hid his face’ (Shemot III, 6) &c.; and from—[Yalkut Isaiah 371 שכרן, read: שִׂבְרָן, see סֵבֶר.]

שָׁלֵם, שָׁלַם (Biblical Hebrew) to be whole, complete; to end, cease. Yerushalmi Sotah VIII, 22ᶜ bottom of page שלום שבימיו שָׁלְמָה וכ׳ Zedekiah was named Shallum, because in his days ended the reign of the house of Judah; Yerushalmi Shekalim VI, 49ᵈ top; Yerushalmi Horayot III, 47ᶜ bottom of page; Bavli Horayot 11ᵇ; Keritot 5ᵇ ששלם (correct accordingly); Yalkut Kings 250; Yalkut Chr. 1085. Pesikta d'Rav Kahana R. section (Parashah) 6 (reference. to I Kings VII, 51) כיון שבא … עכשיו שלמה מלאכת וכ׳ when Solomon came and built the Temple, the Lord said, now the work of heaven and earth (creation) is complete; Yalkut Kings 186 שְׁלֵימָה. Pesikta d'Rav Kahana R. l. common gender. כיון שהִשְׁלִימוּ … שלמה נפשם when the workmen had finished their work, their life was finished (they died); Yalkut l. common gender.; and e.

Hifil - הִשְׁלִים
1) to complete, finish. Pesikta d'Rav Kahana R. l. common gender., see supra. Yerushalmi Rosh Hashanah I, 57ᵃ top; Yerushalmi Sheviit II, 34ᵃ top מכיון שהוא עומד … מַשְׁלִים שנתו since he stands in (has entered) the third year of the tree, he may count it a full year. Yoma 33ᵃ (reference. to Vayikra VI, 5, play on עליה … השלמים) עליה הַשְׁלֵם כל וכ׳ with it (the evening sacrifice) cease all sacrifices (none can be offered after it). Bava Kamma 10ᵃ החופר … והִשְׁלִימָהּ לעשרה if one digs a pit nine cubits deep, and another comes and completes it to the legal size of ten. Berakhot 47ᵇ שחרר … והִשְׁלִימוֹ וכ׳ he freed his slave and used him to complete the quorum of ten persons. Ib. 8ᵇ המשלים פרשיותיו, see פָּרָשָׁה I. Pesikta d'Rav Kahana R. l. common gender. לכך נקרא שלמה שה׳ … לתוך מעשה ידיו he is called Sh’lomoh (perfect), because God caused the work of creation to be perfected through his handiwork (the Temple); Yalkut Kings l. common gender.; and from—Esp. to finish the fast-day. Taanit VII, 9 יַשְׁלִימוּ they must fast the whole day. Yoma 82ᵃ מַשְׁלִימִין they must fast to the end of the day; and from—Part. pass. מוּשְׁלָם perfect, virtuous. Horayot l. common gender. he was named Shallum שהיה מ׳ במעשיו Agadoth hat-Torah (quoted in Rabbinowicz Variæ Lectiones). (ed. משולם) because he was perfect in his deeds; Yalkut Kings 250; Yalkut Chr. l. common gender.

—2) (denominative of שָׁלוֹם) to make friends, or to surrender. Sukkah 52ᵃ (reference. to Mishlei XXV, 22) א"ת יְשַׁלֵּם אלא יַשְׁלִימֶנּוּ לך read not y’shallem (he will pay) but, he will surrender him (the evil spirit) to thee; (comment.; he will make him be friends with thee).—Part. pass. as ab. Bamidabar Rabbah section (Parashah) 74 אחד עשר יום היו מוּשְׁלָמִים לאלהים eleven days were they (the Israelites) at peace with God (adhered to him sincerely); כ"ט יום … מוּשְׁלָמִין twenty-nine days they were sincere servants of God, opposed עשו את העגל. Ib. אינם מושלמים לי וכ׳ (ed. Vilna משלמים, correct accordingly) they will be faithful to me only forty days. Breishit Rabbah section (Parashah) 16, beginning מ׳ לבוראו faithful to his Creator; and e.

Nifal - נִשְׁלַם to be finished, to end. Midrash Tanḥuma Mishpatim 19 המלאך אומר נ׳ פלוני the angel says, such and such has ended (must die).

Piël - שִׁלֵּם
1) to perfect.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּלָּם. Horayot l. common gender., see supra. Yalkut Vayikra 458 מְשׁוּלָּמִים, see שָׁלוֹם.

—2) to compensate, reward, pay. Pesikta d'Rav Kahana R. l. common gender. (play on ותשלם, I Kings VII, 51) עלי לשַׁלֵּם להם מתן שכר it is for me to pay them their reward. Ib. עלי לשלם לו it is for me to compensate it (the month of Kislev) for its loss; ומה ש׳ לו וכ׳ and wherewith did he compensate it? With the dedication under the Hasmonean house. Yerushalmi Taanit II, 65ᵇ top (reference. to Micah VII, 3) שַׁלֵּם לי וַאֲשַׁלֵּם לך (the judge says,) pay me, and I shall pay thee (decide in thy favor). Bava Kamma I, 1 חב המזיק לשלם וכ׳ he that caused the damage is bound to pay &c. Ib. 4 משַׁלֵּם נזק שלם must pay the full indemnity. Bava Metzia III, 1 ש׳ ולא רצה וכ׳ if he pays in preference to making oath. Bava Batra III, 4 מְשַׁלְּמִין לו את הכל they must pay him in full. Pirkei Avot II, 16 שׁיְשַׁלֵּם, see שָׂכָר; and see from

comments.he: לא עליך המלאכה לגמור. את כולה:
ולא אתה בן חורין. ליבטל מכל וכל לכך אם תעשה הרבה תקבל שכר:

sections.en: He [Rabbi Tarfon] used to say: It is not your duty to finish the work, but neither are you at liberty to neglect it; If you have studied much Torah, you shall be given much reward. Faithful is your employer to pay you the reward of your labor; And know that the grant of reward unto the righteous is in the age to come.
sections.he: הוּא הָיָה אוֹמֵר, לֹא עָלֶיךָ הַמְּלָאכָה לִגְמֹר, וְלֹא אַתָּה בֶן חוֹרִין לִבָּטֵל מִמֶּנָּה. אִם לָמַדְתָּ תוֹרָה הַרְבֵּה, נוֹתְנִים לְךָ שָׂכָר הַרְבֵּה. וְנֶאֱמָן הוּא בַעַל מְלַאכְתְּךָ שֶׁיְּשַׁלֵּם לְךָ שְׂכַר פְּעֻלָּתֶךָ. וְדַע מַתַּן שְׂכָרָן שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא:
